item.description:
Thimble 0.6.0 lets notes link files on your Mac, and gives the `thimble` command full control of headings.
- A note can link a file on this Mac, such as a screenshot: `[The board](~/Pictures/Thimble/BenchLog/board.heic)`. Command-click opens it in its own app. The first time, Thimble asks for the file's folder, then opens everything in it. - `thimble headings rename`, `headings move` (`--first` or `--before`), and `headings delete` change a project's headings from the command line and the MCP server. Delete only reports what it would do until you add `--yes`.
